name: process.shell
description: Spawn a process via ShellExecuteEx. Handles paths with spaces / unicode without shell-escape hazards, supports non-default Win32 verbs (runas for elevation, print, edit, explore).

path.description: Absolute path to the file / executable / URL / shell item. ShellExecuteEx handles document-launch semantics — `.txt` opens in Notepad, `.url` follows the link, etc.

args.description: Parameter string passed verbatim to the spawned program. Optional. Used as ShellExecuteEx's lpParameters.

verb.description: Win32 shell verb. `open` (default): standard launch. `runas`: elevate via UAC consent prompt (interactive). `print`: send to default printer. `edit`: open in editor. `explore`: open Explorer at the path. `find`: open search rooted at the path.

cwd.description: Working directory for the new process. Defaults to the agent's cwd.

pid.description: Process id of the spawned process. May be 0 for verbs that don't spawn a new process (e.g. `print` on a file that opens in an existing handler instance).

x-implementations.name: shell_execute_ex_w
x-implementations.description: Win32 `ShellExecuteExW` (Unicode) with SEE_MASK_NOCLOSEPROCESS to retrieve the spawned process handle for pid extraction.

x-implementations.name: shell_execute_ex_a
x-implementations.description: Win32 `ShellExecuteExA` legacy fallback for NT 4 / 9x. ANSI strings transcoded by the agent.

windows-modern.description: ShellExecuteExW. `verb: runas` triggers UAC consent — interactive prompt blocks the agent until the user responds. `user_cancelled` ERR if the user denies the prompt. `no_handler` when no application is registered for the path's file association.

windows-classic.description: ShellExecuteExW on NT 5+; ShellExecuteExA on NT 4 / 9x. `runas` is NT 5+ — pre-NT-5 returns ERR not_supported. NT 4 lacks UAC; `runas` simply uses RunAs Service when present, else errors.
